_doc: Act-0 onboarding chain. A linear sequence of pipeline quests; the loader links each step to unlock the next (chain_unlocks). Each step teaches ONE mechanic; completion is a SOFT predicate (unified vocabulary) the player watches fill — the progress bar is the teacher. Authored body/hint are preserved by the pipeline (voice never clobbers them).

steps.body: The forest is asleep. Wake it: plant a qubit, measure it, then harvest what collapses.
steps.tutorial_hint: R = plant · E = measure · Q = harvest. Do it once in the StarterForest.

steps.body: Each harvest can teach you a new word — an icon. Your vocabulary is your power here.
steps.tutorial_hint: Keep harvesting. Completing a contract or harvesting teaches a new icon pair; your signature grows.

steps.body: Time is the pump. Reap the season — fast-forward, let the Hamiltonian work, and gather the yield.
steps.tutorial_hint: Reap (season change) once to advance time and collect across the biome.

steps.body: A qubit need not pick a side. Superpose it — spread it across both poles — and the forest shimmers between states.
steps.tutorial_hint: Apply a Hadamard gate to raise this biome's coherence past ~0.3. Watch the bar fill.

steps.body: The Millwright's Union is buying. Accept their contract and deliver 2× 🌾 from your stores.
steps.tutorial_hint: Open the quest board, accept the contract, then complete it when you hold enough 🌾.

steps.body: You are The Demos. Plant your vocabulary in the Village and harvest its people — because you KNOW them, every harvest pays more than it costs. This is how the spiral breaks.
steps.tutorial_hint: Grow your signature to 4+. Harvesting icons you KNOW (like 👥 in the Village) yields up to ×4 — net positive forever.

unlock.body: The Hearth Keepers trust you. The forest's deeper rhythms open — walk the Druid's Loop and let the canopy speak.
unlock.tutorial_hint: Your path leans to the forest. Build coherence and berry-phase with the Hearth Keepers.

unlock.body: The Millwright's Union counts you an ally. The mill wants to run — feed it lumber and watch ⚙ rise.
unlock.tutorial_hint: Your path leans to the mill. Drive the Village's ⚙ attractor with the Millwright's Union.
